integrity: Definitions, full induction and enumerator are supplied. Independent-program finite enumeration and explicit checks corroborate but cannot prove unbounded claims; the mathematical proof is the infinite-size justification.
scientific_limitations: The all-size proof applies to finite strict linear orders with a fixed finite nonempty palette of named unary colours, including colours absent from a particular host. Not a result about countably infinite structures or two-sided Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé equivalence; historical priority remains provisional and independent mathematical verification is absent.
title: Permutation-block bases for one-point-extension rank in coloured finite orders
